description: This file implements the MD5 message-digest algorithm, including core functions, context management, and utility functions for computing MD5 hashes.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Internal structure holding MD5 computation state, including buffer, bit counts, and input buffer.

methods.name: byteReverse
methods.description: Reverses byte order in a buffer for little-endian compatibility.

methods.name: MD5Transform
methods.description: Performs the core MD5 transformation on a 64-byte block.

methods.name: MD5Update
methods.description: Updates the MD5 context with new data.

methods.name: MD5Final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash and outputs the digest.

methods.name: MD5IntermediateFinal
methods.description: Computes an intermediate MD5 digest without mutating the original context.

methods.name: MD5DigestToBase16
methods.description: Converts MD5 digest to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: MD5Sum
methods.description: Computes the MD5 digest of raw data.

methods.name: MD5String
methods.description: Computes the MD5 hash of a string and returns it as a hex string.
